contexts.statement: Review the existing family-031 Argus mathematical drafts under OBJECTIVE.md and PRIOR_DRAFTS.json. Conditional statements retain their explicitly listed hypotheses; the old manuscript-error-search objective and the truth of the unaudited manuscript claims are not assumed. This is exploratory scope work, with whole-family acceptance reserved for the native independent Reviewer.

definitions.standard_bridge: K is a number field, B=Q(i), f:G_K->P_B is continuous and surjective, ell is odd, and log(chi_ell composed with f)=log(chi_K,ell).
definitions.epsilon: (chi_ell composed with f)/chi_K,ell; values in mu_(ell-1) under the logarithmic hypothesis.
definitions.F: The fixed field of ker(epsilon), with Delta=Gal(F/K).
definitions.theta_in_bridge: epsilon inverse for the natural Tate-twisted cohomology action.
definitions.S_in_bridge: Exactly all archimedean places and all primes above ell.
definitions.missed: A target finite prime occurring in no ell-active pair for the specified map.
definitions.extensions: General-target and open-image claims explicitly replace the target or surjectivity while retaining logarithmic compatibility.
definitions.archived_literature: The five reused literature records retain their original reviewer producer, assumption subject and old absolute artifact; they are historical attribution, not current native acceptance.

claims.natural_statement: Under these hypotheses: F is a number field; S is finite and contains infinity and all primes above ell; Natural action includes the Tate twist. Unramified-outside-S continuous H1(G_F,Q_ell(1)) is naturally Aut(F,S)-equivariantly O_(F,S)^times tensor Q_ell.

external_assumptions.statement: For a characteristic-zero field F, finite-level Kummer cohomology identifies H1(G_F,mu_(ell^n)) with F^times/(F^times)^(ell^n); for S-integers the associated exact sequence has S-units and ell^n-torsion in the Picard group.
external_assumptions.source: Stacks Project, Kummer theory, tag 03PK, archived 2026-11-05 at research/literature/stacks-03PK.html.
external_assumptions.locator: Lemma 59.28.1 (tag 03PL) and the immediately following H1-to-Picard exact sequence; n is invertible

external_assumptions.statement: The ideal class group of a number field is finite; its quotient, the S-ideal class group, is therefore finite.
external_assumptions.source: J. S. Milne, Algebraic Number Theory, version 3.08, July 19, 2020; archived research/literature/milne-ant.pdf.

external_assumptions.statement: For a number field F and finite S containing infinity, the S-unit group is finitely generated; its pro-ell completion therefore rationalizes to U_S tensor Q_ell.
external_assumptions.source: The finite generation assertion is in Bass, Nagoya Math. J. 27 (1966), archived research/literature/bass1966.pdf; the elementary completion consequence is proved in research/uniform_kummer_bridge.md.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 3, Lemma (Dirichlet, Artin-Tate), p. 402, finite generation assertion

claims.natural_statement: Under these hypotheses: B=Q(i); f:G_K->P_B is a continuous surjection; ell is odd; log(chi_ell composed with f)=log(chi_K,ell); F is fixed by ker(epsilon). Missed-prime Kummer classes retain independence under the specified pullback/restriction and transform by epsilon inverse under the natural Delta action.

claims.natural_statement: Under these hypotheses: The inverse-twist setting; ell is odd; F/K is the finite twist extension of degree dividing ell-1; The map has open image. Restricted missed-prime Kummer classes are unramified at every finite prime of F away from ell, even if F/K is ramified there.

external_assumptions.statement: For an open map between the indicated global solvably closed Galois groups and odd ell, surviving pro-ell inertia at a source prime away from ell is case (ii): the full decomposition image lies in a unique finite target decomposition group away from ell, and the pro-ell inertia maps into target inertia. No cofinite-coverage conclusion is used here.
external_assumptions.source: Uchida, JMSJ 33 (1981), primary journal PDF archived at research/literature/uchida1981-journal.pdf.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 1, pp. 595-596, uniqueness and case (ii), with exclusion of case (iii) for odd ell

claims.natural_statement: Under these hypotheses: Finite cyclic F/K with group Delta; Finite Delta-stable S containing infinity; One-dimensional Q_ell-valued theta. dim(U_S tensor Q_ell)^theta = sum_(v in S/Delta)1_(theta|D_v=1) - 1_(theta=1).

external_assumptions.statement: For a finite Galois extension F/K and finite set T of places of K containing infinity, the rational S-unit representation plus one trivial representation is the permutation representation on the places S of F above T; equivalently Q tensor (U_S direct-sum Z) is the sum of the place permutation modules.
external_assumptions.source: Bass, Generators and relations for cyclotomic units, Nagoya Math. J. 27 (1966), archived research/literature/bass1966.pdf.
external_assumptions.locator: Section 3, Lemma (Dirichlet, Artin-Tate), pp. 402-403

claims.natural_statement: Under these hypotheses: K is a number field; B=Q(i); f:G_K->P_B is a continuous surjection; ell is odd; log(chi_ell composed with f)=log(chi_K,ell); F is fixed by ker(epsilon). The number of missed target primes away from ell is at most r1_split(F/K)+r2(K)+g_ell_split(F/K)-1_(epsilon=1), hence at most 2[K:Q]; total at most 2[K:Q]+2.

claims.natural_statement: For distinct rational primes p_j different from ell, the classes a_n=product_(1<=j<n) p_j^(ell^j) mod (Q^times)^(ell^n) are compatible and have nonzero valuation ell^j at every p_j. Thus the full pro-ell multiplicative completion need not have finite valuation support. This construction is not unramified outside any finite S and does not refute the unramified Kummer lemma.

Under these hypotheses: N is a number field contained in Q^s; f:G_K->P_N is a continuous surjection; ell is odd; The same logarithmic compatibility holds; Missed primes are defined for the target N. For finite N contained in Q^s, the same away-from-ell bound holds, with total bound 2[K:Q]+g_ell(N).

claims.natural_statement: The reviewed old bridge and certificate do not certify C_LOG_RANK, C_SIGNED_REPRESENTATION, C_AMPLIFICATION or C_NORMALIZED. In particular, surjectivity and logarithmic compatibility of the constructed map remain upstream application obligations; the rational S-unit representation does not establish logarithm rank in the actual local image.

The reviewed old bridge supplies a conditional uniform-bound input but does not certify L_NORM_IDENTITY, C_FINITE_FIBERS, C_POWER_SEPARATION or C_SAME_CHARACTERISTIC. The finite-fiber deduction has identified character prerequisites; simultaneous overlapping-list power separation and the residue-characteristic matching chain remain separate obligations.

The reviewed old bridge does not certify C_ANABELIAN_INPUTS, C_IDENTIFICATION or C_MAIN. Equality of selected cyclotomic logarithms does not alone give full adelic cyclotomic equality, a conjugating element, or embedding existence and uniqueness. The old adversarial mission C9000031 is not the present objective.

routes.retired_because: The compatible classes product_(j<n) p_j^(ell^j) in the full pro-ell completion have infinitely many nonzero valuation coordinates. Finite support is false; the finite-level S-class-group sequence with multiplication-by-ell transition replaces this shortcut. This is a known failed old route, not a counterexample to the manuscript lemma.
